name: Czechia — Czech parties
intro: compare it with Czech political parties
inclusion_note: The test includes the main national parties of Czechia: those represented in the parliament (Poslanecká sněmovna) and those with a significant national following. Positions are the team's estimates and are open to review.
hemicycle_note: Seats in the parliament (Poslanecká sněmovna) after the 2025 election, arranged left to right. Approximate. 200 members. Parties shown without seats are included because they poll strongly.

Stačilo!.name: Stačilo!
Stačilo!.priorities: Diplomacy with Russia, no arms deliveries, Cost of living, National sovereignty
Stačilo!.description: Left-populist alliance led by the Communist Party, opposed to aid for Ukraine and critical of the EU and NATO; it narrowly missed parliament in 2025.

Piráti.name: Česká pirátská strana
Piráti.priorities: Transparency and digital rights, Digital innovation, Civil liberties, Affordable housing
Piráti.description: Pirate Party, focused on transparency, digital government and civil liberties.

Volt.name: Volt Česko
Volt.priorities: Deeper European integration, Climate action, Digital innovation, Democratic reform
Volt.description: National chapter of Volt Europa, the first pan-European party. All chapters share one programme: a federal and more democratic EU, evidence-based policy, a market economy with a strong welfare state, and the digital and climate transitions. Volt has the same positions in every country in this test.

STAN.name: Starostové a nezávislí
STAN.priorities: Regions and rural services, Education, Deeper European integration
STAN.description: Mayors and Independents, a centrist party rooted in local government, liberal and pro-European.

SPOLU.name: SPOLU (ODS, KDU-ČSL, TOP 09)
SPOLU.priorities: Fiscal discipline, Defence and support for Ukraine, Competitiveness and growth
SPOLU.description: Centre-right alliance of the Civic Democrats, Christian Democrats and TOP 09 that governed from 2021 to 2025; strongly pro-Ukraine and fiscally conservative.

ANO.name: ANO 2011
ANO.priorities: Cost of living, Pensions and the elderly, Reducing immigration, National sovereignty
ANO.description: Populist party of billionaire Andrej Babiš, which won the 2025 election; it promises higher pensions and lower energy prices and is critical of the Green Deal and migration.

Motoristé.name: Motoristé sobě
Motoristé.priorities: Less red tape, National sovereignty, Cost of living
Motoristé.description: Motorists for Themselves, a right-wing party opposed to the EU's ban on combustion engines and to climate regulation.

SPD.name: Svoboda a přímá demokracie
SPD.priorities: Reducing immigration, Direct democracy, National sovereignty
SPD.description: Freedom and Direct Democracy, a far-right party calling for referendums on leaving the EU and NATO and for zero immigration.
